acceptance_criteria.criterion: `CompletePipelineSchema` accepts a bare `string` for `handoff_notes` without a Zod parse error
Inside `completePipeline()`, a bare-string `handoff_notes` is coerced to a one-element array before use
The downstream `note.notes` field in the persisted `HandoffNote` is always `string[]`
`npx vitest run` in `mcp-server/` passes with no regressions

summary: Changed `handoff_notes` schema in `CompletePipelineSchema` from `z.array(z.string()).optional()` to `z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]).optional()` in `mcp-server/src/tools/pipeline.ts`. Added `normalizedHandoffNotes` normalization in `completePipeline()` (bare string → single-element array, mirroring the existing `normalizedSummary` pattern), and spread it into the `args` const. Added 7 new tests in `pipeline.test.ts`: 3 schema acceptance tests (bare string, string[], undefined) and 4 handler normalization tests (bare string coerced, string[] preserved, omitted no-op, HandoffNote.notes always string[]).

comments.note: `mcp-server/src/tools/pipeline.ts`: the `normalizedHandoffNotes` block (3 lines) and `normalizedSummary` block (2 lines) are structurally identical. A small helper `normalizeStringOrArray(val: string | string[] | undefined): string[] | undefined` would eliminate the duplication if a third field ever needs the same treatment.

`mcp-server/tests/tools/pipeline.test.ts`: the test 'preserves a string[] handoff_notes as-is' and 'omitting handoff_notes does not create a HandoffNote entry' both call `store.writeWorkPackage` to reset the WP to IN_PROGRESS. This is necessary because `completePipeline` mutates the pipeline state, but it slightly couples test order. Using `beforeEach` to reset state for each test in the block would be cleaner; low priority since the test order is stable.
`mcp-server/tests/gui/dialogue-qa.test.ts` has 14 pre-existing failing tests (DOM querySelector errors). These are unrelated to this WP but represent outstanding technical debt in the test suite.

summary: Verified all 6 acceptance criteria for handoff_notes schema change. AC1 (bare string accepted): PASS — Zod z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]) accepts bare strings. AC2 (string[] still accepted): PASS — existing array form preserved. AC3 (undefined/omitted accepted): PASS — .optional() preserves backward compat. AC4 (bare string coerced to single-element array): PASS — normalizedHandoffNotes in completePipeline() uses same pattern as normalizedSummary. AC5 (HandoffNote.notes always string[]): PASS — normalized form spread into args before persistence. AC6 (vitest passes no regressions): PASS — 108/108 pipeline.test.ts, 137/137 workflow-handoff.test.ts. Full suite: 1696/1710 passing (14 pre-existing dialogue-qa.test.ts DOM failures unrelated to this WP, confirmed as pre-existing from developer pipeline). Handoff note verification: (1) bare-string round-trips through full MCP call confirmed in test 'coerces a bare-string handoff_notes to a one-element array in the persisted HandoffNote'; (2) Zod union only accepts string | string[], not numbers (union members are string and array(string)); (3) workflow-handoff.test.ts all 137 tests pass — no regressions from string[] handoff_notes.

comments.note: Zod union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]) correctly rejects non-string types like numbers — a number is not a member of either branch of the union. Confirmed by schema design (union has exactly two branches: string and string[]).

The 14 pre-existing failures in tests/gui/dialogue-qa.test.ts are DOM querySelector null errors unrelated to this WP. They existed before this change as documented in the developer's implementation comment.

The normalizedHandoffNotes block (3 lines) and normalizedSummary block (2 lines) in pipeline.ts are structurally identical — developer noted this. Could be extracted to a shared helper if a third field needs same treatment. Low priority.

summary: Reviewed `mcp-server/src/tools/pipeline.ts` and `mcp-server/tests/tools/pipeline.test.ts` for WP-003 (`handoff_notes` bare-string coercion).

Schema change is minimal and correct: `z.array(z.string()).optional()` → `z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]).optional()`. The union is tightly typed — only `string` and `string[]` pass; other types (numbers, objects) are correctly rejected.

Coercion logic in `completePipeline()` mirrors the existing `normalizedSummary` pattern exactly — `undefined` is preserved, bare string is wrapped in `[str]`, array is passed through as-is. The `normalizedHandoffNotes` is correctly spread into `args` before all downstream use including persistence at line 574-591.

7 new tests cover all 6 AC: 3 schema-parse tests (string, string[], undefined) and 4 handler integration tests (coerce, preserve array, omit no-op, notes always string[]). All 108 pipeline.test.ts tests confirmed passing.
Two low-priority cosmetic observations from Developer (helper extraction, test reset coupling) are non-blocking.

comments.note: `pipeline.ts`: `normalizedHandoffNotes` (3 lines) and `normalizedSummary` (2 lines) are structurally identical normalization blocks. A shared `normalizeStringOrArray(val: string | string[] | undefined): string[] | undefined` helper would eliminate duplication if a third field ever needs it. Current duplication is acceptable at this scale.

`pipeline.test.ts` `preserves a string[] handoff_notes as-is` and `omitting handoff_notes does not create a HandoffNote entry` both call `store.writeWorkPackage` to reset the WP to IN_PROGRESS. A shared `beforeEach` reset per test would be cleaner. Current approach is stable and poses no correctness risk.

No concerns with the `as any` type assertion on `handoff_notes: 'bare string' as any` in the handler normalization test — this is appropriate here since the test explicitly exercises coercion of a type that TS would normally reject at compile time.

notes: QA should verify: (1) bare-string `handoff_notes` round-trips correctly through the full MCP call (not just the internal function), (2) the Zod union schema doesn't inadvertently accept other types (e.g. numbers), (3) regression on existing `workflow-handoff.test.ts` tests that pass string[] `handoff_notes`.

All 6 AC verified. handoff_notes Zod schema accepts bare string, string[], and undefined. Bare string correctly coerced to string[] before persistence. 108/108 pipeline tests pass, 137/137 workflow-handoff tests pass. 14 pre-existing dialogue-qa GUI failures unchanged. Ready for code-review.
All 6 AC confirmed met. 108/108 pipeline.test.ts tests pass. Implementation is minimal, correct, and consistent with the existing normalizedSummary pattern. Ready for Documentation.
